en: Because you just need a robot, you just need a drone.
zh: 因为你只需要一个机器人，你只需要一架无人机。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if it will be fully automatic, nope.
zh: 而如果它将是全自动的，那就不行了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay, if it will be like a semi-automatic, like in our interceptors, it will be crazy.
zh: 好的，如果它是像半自动的那种，比如在我们的拦截机里那样，那会很疯狂。

speaker: Unknown
en: But for now, why we don't use the semi-automatic AI in our ordinary drones?
zh: 但就目前而言，为什么我们在普通无人机上不使用半自动的 AI?

speaker: Unknown
en: Because it gives us more high price for these drones.
zh: 因为它使这些无人机的价格更高。

speaker: Unknown
en: You don't need it.
zh: 你不需要它。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you can, for our military battery, if you can buy like a...
zh: 如果可以的话，对我们的军事单位来说，如果你能买像……

speaker: Unknown
en: If you buy five ordinary FPV without AI, it will be better than you can buy one FPV with AI.
zh: 如果你买五架不带 AI 的普通 FPV,会比你能买一架带 AI 的 FPV 更好。

speaker: Unknown
en: But we'll see, because we are talking about the technologies, and I think that the technologies will be... We will see very fast scaling of these technologies, and we will see that the price will be lower and lower.
zh: 但我们拭目以待，因为我们在谈论技术，我认为技术将会……我们会看到这些技术非常快速的规模化，而且我们会看到价格会越来越低。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it will be very, very scary for everybody.
zh: 而这对每个人来说都会非常、非常可怕。

speaker: Unknown
en: Very scary.
zh: 非常可怕。

speaker: Unknown
en: So, we'll see, but I think that for us, the general point is the most important point for us now, is to make the fully autonomous interceptor system.
zh: 所以，我们拭目以待，但我认为对我们来说，总体目标是我们现在最重要的目标，就是制造完全自主的拦截系统。

speaker: Unknown
en: So, when you can take this drone in some kind of box, go...
zh: 所以，当你可以把这架无人机放进某种箱子里，然后走……

speaker: Unknown
en: carry it on the board or maybe some on the deep ground and just use it only for one button.
zh: 把它带上载具，或者也许带到纵深地带的某处，然后只用一个按钮就能使用它。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it will be great for us.
zh: 所以这对我们来说会很棒。

speaker: Unknown
en: We will see.
zh: 我们拭目以待。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I don't want to think about the AI technologies in the ordinary battlefield because it will be...
zh: 但我不想考虑 AI 技术在普通战场上的运用，因为那将会……

speaker: Unknown
en: Very, very bad for both sides.
zh: 对双方都非常、非常糟糕。

speaker: Unknown
en: Of course, we want that's the best set for our enemies, but we know that we take some technologies from enemies.
zh: 当然，我们希望那是给我们的敌人的最好的东西，但我们知道我们会从敌人那里拿取一些技术。

speaker: Unknown
en: Technical enemies take technologies from us.
zh: 技术上的敌人也从我们这里拿取技术。

speaker: Unknown
en: So if we will have this technology, they will have this technology maybe in a week or two.
zh: 所以如果我们将会拥有这项技术，他们也许在一两周内就会拥有这项技术。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, that was one of the questions.
zh: 好吧，那是其中一个问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: And about this widening kill zone.
zh: 还有关于这个不断扩大的杀伤区。

speaker: Unknown
en: and the blurring of the front line as these weapons become more effective and can operate at a greater distance.
zh: 以及随着这些武器变得更有效、能在更远距离上运作，前线变得模糊。

speaker: Unknown
en: Are you seeing the Russians keep up with the technology as fast as you?
zh: 你看到俄罗斯人像你们一样快速跟上这项技术吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: And do they have interceptor drones that are as effective?
zh: 他们有同样有效的拦截无人机吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: I think that we should talk about two different systems, two different types of understanding of the technologies, because I think that Ukraine is better and faster in constructing something new, something new technologies, but Russia, of course...
zh: 我认为我们应该谈谈两种不同的体系，两种不同类型的技术理解方式，因为我认为乌克兰在构建新东西、新技术方面更好更快，但俄罗斯当然……

speaker: Unknown
en: The more better than us in scaling of this technology.
zh: 在这项技术的规模化上比我们更强。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's just a matter of their industrial... Yeah, yeah, yeah.
zh: 而这只是他们工业……的问题。是的，是的，是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's about different because we live in capitalistic Ukraine.
zh: 这是因为我们生活在资本主义的乌克兰。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have different companies.
zh: 我们有不同的公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have...
zh: 我们有……

speaker: Unknown
en: We have different markets, relationships, and so on.
zh: 我们有不同的市场、关系等等。

speaker: Unknown
en: In Russia, you have strong classic tyranny, vertical, and you can scale everything very fast.
zh: 在俄罗斯，有强大的经典专制、垂直体系，你可以非常快地把一切规模化。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, yeah.
zh: 是的，是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So this hasn't prevented... You're not winning the war because you have...
zh: 所以这并没有妨碍……你们赢得战争并不是因为你们有……

speaker: Unknown
en: Interceptor drones or FPV drones or you're just maintaining the line or the zone.
zh: 拦截无人机或 FPV 无人机，还是你们只是在维持这条线或这个区域？

speaker: Unknown
en: We call it like asymmetrical solutions.
zh: 我们称之为非对称解决方案。

speaker: Unknown
en: Of course, we haven't so much soldiers like Russia.
zh: 当然，我们没有像俄罗斯那么多的士兵。

speaker: Unknown
en: Of course, we haven't so much bloody oil money like Russia.
zh: 当然，我们没有像俄罗斯那么多血腥的石油钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: Of course, we haven't so much vehicles or other, other, other like Russia.
zh: 当然，我们没有像俄罗斯那么多的车辆或其他、其他、其他东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: Of course, we destroyed a lot of Russian techniques, so they use horses.
zh: 当然，我们摧毁了很多俄罗斯的装备，所以他们用马。

speaker: Unknown
en: But anyway, we haven't.
zh: 但不管怎样，我们没有。

speaker: Unknown
en: But we have our smart and we have our understanding that we need something asymmetrical and we made it.
zh: 但我们有我们的聪明才智，我们有我们的理解，知道我们需要非对称的东西，而我们做到了。

speaker: Unknown
en: We made these drones, FPV drones in 2022.
zh: 我们在2022年制造了这些无人机，FPV 无人机。

speaker: Unknown
en: No, not made, but re-understand the views of these runs in 2022.
zh: 不，不是制造，而是在2022年重新理解了这些 runs 的视角。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we show to the world that in modern war it's not important how big and how many people you have.
zh: 我们向世界展示了，在现代战争中，你有多强大、有多少人并不重要。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you have technologies, very cheap technologies, you can take this war and you can win this war.
zh: 如果你有技术，非常便宜的技术，你就能掌控这场战争，你就能赢得这场战争。

speaker: Unknown
en: We still believe that we can win this war.
zh: 我们仍然相信我们能赢得这场战争。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think that it's not about the land.
zh: 而且我认为这不是关于土地。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's about our understanding.
zh: 这是关于我们的理解。

speaker: Unknown
en: We truly understand that Ukraine is not a part of Russia.
zh: 我们真正明白，乌克兰不是俄罗斯的一部分。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we showed it during these four years.
zh: 我们在这四年里展示了这一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we showed that if they will have some questions to us in the future, we will have the good answers to these questions.
zh: 我们还展示了，如果他们将来对我们有一些问题，我们会对这些问题有好的答案。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I know you have to go, but my last question is the future.
zh: 我知道你得走了，但我的最后一个问题是关于未来。

speaker: Unknown
en: The war will end.
zh: 战争会结束。

speaker: Unknown
en: We all hope.
zh: 我们都希望如此。

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, certainly it will end someday.
zh: 我的意思是，它肯定有一天会结束。

speaker: Unknown
en: Ukraine has developed this drone industry.
zh: 乌克兰已经发展出了这个无人机产业。

speaker: Unknown
en: What happens to that industry after?
zh: 那之后这个产业会怎样？

speaker: Unknown
en: We're actively working now for our international expansion, so we want to do this not only because of money, but because we think about our partners, about our Western partners, and we want to help our Western partners to make
zh: 我们现在正积极致力于我们的国际扩张，我们想这样做不仅是为了钱，还因为我们考虑我们的伙伴，我们的西方伙伴，我们想帮助我们的西方伙伴去打造

speaker: Unknown
en: big and very good defense system because only we in Russia know how to operate in this modern world.
zh: 庞大且非常好的防御系统，因为只有我们在俄罗斯才知道如何在这个现代世界中运作。

speaker: Unknown
en: And of course, we want to export our drones.
zh: 当然，我们想出口我们的无人机。

speaker: Unknown
en: Of course, we want to make some maybe joint factory and joint ventures with different companies from USA or from Europe.
zh: 当然，我们想与来自美国或欧洲的不同公司建立一些，也许是，联合工厂和合资企业。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we actively work on this way because we have a lot of conversation from Riga to Los Angeles.
zh: 我们在这条路上积极工作，因为我们有很多对话，从里加到洛杉矶。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we're trying to find good partners because we don't need the money.
zh: 我们在努力寻找好的伙伴，因为我们不需要钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: Of course, we are open for investments, we're open for different type of venture.
zh: 当然，我们对投资持开放态度，我们对不同类型的风投持开放态度。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's not a problem.
zh: 这不是问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: But first of all, we need...
zh: 但首先，我们需要……

speaker: Unknown
en: good R&D and technologies.
zh: 好的研发和技术。

speaker: Unknown
en: We need good engineers from the West who can help us to make this product better because we have a lot of our expertise from the front, from the battlefield.
zh: 我们需要来自西方的优秀工程师，他们能帮我们把这款产品做得更好，因为我们的很多专业知识来自前线，来自战场。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if we will help this accept to the Western maybe institutes or maybe the Western best engineers, we can combine it and make something really... Yeah.
zh: 而且如果我们能帮助这个被西方的、也许是研究所、或者也许是西方最好的工程师接受，我们可以把它结合起来，做出真正……的东西。是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, are you looking beyond defense?
zh: 我是说，你们有没有考虑国防之外的领域？

speaker: Unknown
en: Are there commercial non-defense applications?
zh: 有没有商业上的非国防应用？

speaker: Unknown
en: Non-defense?
zh: 非国防？

speaker: Unknown
en: I can do this.
zh: 我可以做到这个。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think that we should start to think about the drones not only about during the war, we should start thinking about the drones like in our civil life, because if we can make some kind of...
zh: 我认为我们应该开始思考无人机，不仅仅是在战争期间，我们应该开始在平民生活中思考无人机，因为如果我们能做出某种……

speaker: Unknown
en: Because we will see, we will see that drones will be used by different, maybe different terrorist groups, maybe different for different murders, assassination as other as other.
zh: 因为我们会看到，我们会看到无人机会被不同的、也许不同的恐怖组织使用，也许不同的用于不同的谋杀、暗杀，如同其他，如同其他。

speaker: Unknown
en: We will see it.
zh: 我们会看到的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we open to work not only with militars,
zh: 所以我们开放不仅与军人们合作，

speaker: Unknown
en: But with different security services, different police national guard from different countries.
zh: 而是与不同的安全部门、来自不同国家的不同的警察国民警卫队合作。

speaker: Unknown
en: And, of course, we openly work with big corporations who want to make their own security from drones, because drones are not only about...
zh: 而且，当然，我们公开与想要建立自己针对无人机安全的大公司合作，因为无人机不仅仅是关于……

speaker: Unknown
en: Kamikaze drones is not only about targeting.
zh: 神风无人机不仅仅是关于瞄准。

speaker: Unknown
en: Drones is about intelligence.
zh: 无人机关乎情报。

speaker: Unknown
en: Drones is about blackmailing.
zh: 无人机关乎勒索。

speaker: Unknown
en: Drones is about not legal cargo delivery and other, other, other.
zh: 无人机关乎不合法的货物运输，还有其他、其他、其他。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we understand drones and we know how to operate it and we know how to destroy it.
zh: 所以我们了解无人机，我们知道如何操作它，我们也知道如何摧毁它。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we are open to different collaborations in different ways.
zh: 所以我们以不同的方式开放不同的合作。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like example,
zh: 举个例子，

speaker: Unknown
en: When the era of internet came to us, every company, every government structure started to make some kind of cybersecurity services.
zh: 当互联网时代来到我们身边时，每家公司、每个政府结构都开始建立某种网络安全服务。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, I think that we started the era of drones and every department in every government
zh: 现在，我认为我们开启了无人机的时代，每个政府中的每个部门

speaker: Unknown
en: In every big company, not big company, in every company will make some kind of drone security department and this drone security department should write these rules of security because it's very important for us.
zh: 在每家大公司——不是大公司，是每家公司——都会建立某种无人机安全部门，而这个无人机安全部门应该编写这些安全规则，因为这对我们来说非常重要。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we open to show our expertise in it.
zh: 而且我们开放展示我们在其中的专业知识。

speaker: Unknown
en: We open for it.
zh: 我们对此持开放态度。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay, well let's leave it there.
zh: 好，那我们就在这里结束吧。
